description: This file defines a data migration class 'DefaultScopesMigration' for setting up default OpenID Connect scopes in an OrchardCore module. It includes methods to create scopes like Email, Profile, Phone, and Roles if they do not already exist.

classes.name: DefaultScopesMigration
classes.description: A data migration class that initializes default OpenID scopes during setup.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates default scopes (Email, Profile, Phone, Roles) if they do not exist.

methods.name: UpdateFrom1
methods.description: Ensures the 'Roles' scope exists, used for migration updates.
